passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.892
passages.text: induit Aeneas alloquiturque Iovem:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.893
passages.text: ‘hostica Tyrrheno vota est vindemia regi:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.894
passages.text: Iuppiter, e Latio palmite musta feres!’

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.895
passages.text: vota valent meliora, cadit Mezentius ingens

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.896
passages.text: atque indignanti pectore plangit humum,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.897
passages.text: venerat Autumnus calcatis sordidus uvis:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.898
passages.text: redduntur merito debita vina Iovi.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.899
passages.text: dicta dies hinc est Vinalia: Iuppiter illam

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.900
passages.text: vindicat et festis gaudet inesse suis,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.901
passages.text: Sex ubi, quae restant, luces Aprilis habebit,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.902
passages.text: in medio cursu tempora veris erunt,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.903
passages.text: et frustra pecudem quaeres Athamantidos Helles,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.904
passages.text: signaque dant imbres, exoriturque Canis.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.905
passages.text: hac mihi Nomento Romam cum luce redirem,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.906
passages.text: obstitit in media candida turba via.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.907
passages.text: flamen in antiquae lucum Robiginis ibat,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.908
passages.text: exta canis flammis, exta daturus ovis.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.909
passages.text: protinus accessi, ritus ne nescius essem:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.910
passages.text: edidit haec flamen verba, Quirine, tuus:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.911
passages.text: ‘aspera Robigo, parcas Cerialibus herbis,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.912
passages.text: et tremat in summa leve cacumen humo.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.913
passages.text: tu sata sideribus caeli nutrita secundis

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.914
passages.text: crescere, dum fiant falcibus apta, sinas.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.915
passages.text: vis tua non levis est: quae tu frumenta notasti,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.916
passages.text: maestus in amissis illa colonus habet,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.917
passages.text: nec venti tantum Cereri nocuere nec imbres,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.918
passages.text: nec sic marmoreo pallet adusta gelu,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.919
passages.text: quantum, si culmos Titan incalfacit udos:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.920
passages.text: tunc locus est irae, diva timenda, tuae.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.921
passages.text: parce, precor, scabrasque manus a messibus aufer

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.922
passages.text: neve noce cultis: posse nocere sat est.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.923
passages.text: nec teneras segetes, sed durum amplectere ferrum,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.924
passages.text: quodque potest alios perdere, perde prior.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.925
passages.text: utilius gladios et tela nocentia carpes:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.926
passages.text: nil opus est illis, otia mundus agit.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.927
passages.text: sarcula nunc durusque bidens et vomer aduncus,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.928
passages.text: ruris opes, niteant; inquinet arma situs,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.929
passages.text: conatusque aliquis vagina ducere ferrum

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.930
passages.text: adstrictum longa sentiat esse mora.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.931
passages.text: at tu ne viola Cererem, semperque colonus

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.932
passages.text: absenti possit solvere vota tibi.’

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.933
passages.text: dixerat: a dextra villis mantele solutis

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.934
passages.text: cumque meri patera turis acerra fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.935
passages.text: tura focis vinumque dedit fibrasque bidentis

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.936
passages.text: turpiaque obscenae (vidimus) exta canis.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.937
passages.text: tum mihi cur detur sacris nova victima, quaeris? (

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.938
passages.text: quaesieram) causam percipe flamen ait.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.939
passages.text: ‘est Canis, Icarium dicunt, quo sidere moto

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.940
passages.text: tosta sitit tellus, praecipiturque seges,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.941
passages.text: pro cane sidereo canis hic imponitur arae,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.942
passages.text: et quare pereat, nil nisi nomen habet.’

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.943
passages.text: Cum Phrygis Assaraci Tithonia fratre relicto

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.944
passages.text: sustulit inmenso ter iubar orbe suum,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.945
passages.text: mille venit variis florum dea nexa coronis:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.946
passages.text: scaena ioci morem liberioris habet.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.947
passages.text: exit et in Maias sacrum Florale Kalendas;

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.948
passages.text: tunc repetam, nunc me grandius urget opus.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.949
passages.text: aufer Vesta diem! cognati Vesta recepta est

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.950
passages.text: limine: sic iusti constituere patres.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.951
passages.text: Phoebus habet partem, Vestae pars altera cessit;

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.952
passages.text: quod superest illis, tertius ipse tenet,

passages.text: state Palatinae laurus, praetextaque quercu

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 4.954
passages.text: stet domus: aeternos tres habet una deos.
